question: A customer needs to move their system from the current version of SAP S/4HANA (on-premise) to SAP S/4HANA Cloud, private edition. What type of transition do you recommend? A. System Upgrade B. Lift & Shift C. System Conversion D. Selective Data Transition

What are some activities SAP is responsible for during an upgrade to SAP S/4HANA Cloud, private edition? (Choose two.) A. Tasks in the Software Update Manager B. Tasks listed in the Simplification Item Check C. Tasks in Client 000 D. Tasks in the SAP Readiness Check

What are some relevant activities for an SAP S/4HANA Cloud, private edition upgrade? (Choose two.) A. SAP informs the customer when a new upgrade is available. B. Customer requests the upgrade as part of the yearly entitlement. C. SAP automatically upgrades the system within the agreed maintenance windows. D. SAP performs the technical upgrade tasks and the customer is responsible for additional tasks.

When is a customer required to upgrade their SAP S/4HANA Cloud, private edition system? A. When the current base release has only 12 months of mainstream maintenance remaining. B. When two support packs have been released for the current base release. C. When the latest base release is launched. D. When the base release falls out of mainstream maintenance.
